title: Tamil Months
label: ch:ta-tamil-months
canDo: I can name the twelve months of the Tamil solar calendar and place Tamil New Year and Pongal inside it.

payoff.summary: Recite Chithirai through Panguṉi, then date Tamil New Year to Chithirai 1 and Pongal to Thai 1.
payoff.note: Below the 0.5 floor by sequence, not by omission: TA-C16-thamizh-maadangal (600) is the chapter's only spoken lesson and assesses both of its own atoms. The other four — ம (TA-SCRIPT-DRIZZLE-07, TA-S07-ma, 605), the independent ஆ and a hand-written ஆம் (TA-SCRIPT-INDEPENDENT-VOWEL-AA-01, TA-SCRIPT-WRITE-AAM-02, TA-W05-write-aam, 610) and ஆ (TA-SCRIPT-RECOG-120, TA-S120-letter-aa, 611) — are taught by script lessons sequenced after it, so the payoff cannot honestly assess them and none of those lessons is a fitting payoff for the months.
